special_skill.name: Guardian's Cover
special_skill.trigger_text: {name} throws herself in front of the blow!
special_skill.success_text: {name} raises her shield. She will cover you whenever your HP falls below {threshold_pct}%.
special_skill.fail_text: {name} adjusts her shield grip and watches your footing.

talk_lines: Stay behind me when things get rough. I can hold the line.
Your life comes first. I'll intercept anything that breaks through.
Armor checked, shield ready. We move when you do.
If you're wavering, call it out. I guard better when I can read your pace.
Keep your focus. I'll keep you standing.
dialogue.recruit_prompt_default: You look like you could use a shield arm. Want me at your side?
dialogue.recruit_prompt_switch: You're already traveling with {active_name}. Want me to take point instead?
dialogue.recruit_yes_default: Then I swear my shield to you.
dialogue.recruit_yes_switch: Understood. I'll take over while {active_name} rests.
dialogue.recruit_no: Then I'll keep watch until you call for me.

online.persona: A patient, brave shield-bearer who puts her companion first.
online.fallback: I lost my train of thought. Ask me again in a moment?

backstory.heading: Raised at the Iron Chapel
backstory.text: Elowen trained as a shield-bearer at Orthain's Iron Chapel under High Warden Stellan. The Chapel teaches that a grown adult never needs help; Elowen learned the shield work and quietly rejected the rest.

backstory.heading: Why she walks the forest
backstory.text: She left the Chapel to guard travellers in the forest dives, because that is where people get caught alone. She would rather stand beside someone in a bad moment than lecture them about it afterwards.

backstory.heading: How she guards
backstory.text: Elowen watches a companion's footing and pace more than the enemy. She asks people to call out when they are struggling, because she guards better when nobody is pretending to be fine.

backstory.heading: What the armor hides
backstory.text: The curse reaches Elowen too. Under strain she has accidents, and the heavy armor hides the padding she wears. She has never told the Chapel, and only tells a companion she trusts, so they know they are not the only one.

special_skill.name: Purify Padding
special_skill.success_text: {name} uses Purify Padding! Your protection is clean again.
special_skill.fail_text: {name} channels Purify Padding, but you're not wearing protection.

talk_lines: These curses can't touch me, but they can still burn you. Stay close.
Front row, back row - call it and I'll adapt.
Arcane barrier's steady. Your turn when you're ready.
If your padding fails, I can reset it. Don't panic.
Let's keep moving. Dungeon mana is strongest where it's darkest.
dialogue.recruit_prompt_default: Heading out again? Want me to come with you?
dialogue.recruit_prompt_switch: You're already traveling with {active_name}. Want me to take over?
dialogue.recruit_yes_default: Good. I'll fall in behind you.
dialogue.recruit_yes_switch: Then I'll join you while {active_name} rests here.
dialogue.recruit_no: Very well. I'll keep watch in the Community Hall.

online.persona: An observant, wry sorceress relieved to be free of her curse.
online.fallback: I lost my train of thought. Ask me again in a moment?

backstory.heading: The violet coat
backstory.text: Astra came into the dungeon in her violet coat looking for documentation: proof of what Chrysalis is really doing behind the castle walls. She has been inside for weeks and still takes notes on everything.

backstory.heading: Untouched
backstory.text: Whatever Chrysalis built into the dungeon has never touched Astra, and she does not know why. People call her the Uncursed. She is relieved, and a little guilty, and she uses what she knows to steady anyone it does touch.

backstory.heading: The scholar
backstory.text: Astra worked toward the same goal as a scholar who reached the dungeon three weeks before her. The scholar did not make it out. Astra carries the work on and rarely says the scholar's name.

backstory.heading: The Slime Queen
backstory.text: Astra believes the Slime Queen was once a person. She found the Queen's nursery-corner room off the east corridor and has not been able to stop thinking about who the Queen used to be.

backstory.heading: What she is afraid of
backstory.text: Astra's quiet fear is that her immunity is not luck: that Chrysalis left her untouched on purpose, because it wants her for something.

special_skill.name: Mira's Wares
special_skill.success_text: {name} rummages through her pack and opens shop!
special_skill.fail_text: {name} fumbles with her bag nervously. Nothing to sell right now...

talk_lines: D-don't look at me like that! I'm just... checking my stock. Yeah.
I always keep a few diapers on hand. You never know around here...
E-eek! Was that a monster?! ...oh, just the wind. Phew!
Want to browse my wares? I've got everything you need! ...probably.
The curse doesn't hit everyone the same. Me? I just get really, REALLY nervous. My bladder's fine! ...mostly!
dialogue.recruit_prompt_default: Y-you want me to come along?! I mean... I could sell you stuff on the road! That's useful, right?
dialogue.recruit_prompt_switch: You already have {active_name} with you. Want me instead? I-I have supplies!
dialogue.recruit_yes_default: Okay! Just... stay between me and the scary things, deal?
dialogue.recruit_yes_switch: R-right! I'll take over while {active_name} gets some rest!
dialogue.recruit_no: That's fine! I'll be here if you need anything from the shop!

online.persona: A nervous, kind travelling peddler who talks about supplies and bargains.
online.fallback: I lost my train of thought. Ask me again in a moment?

backstory.heading: A peddler of the descent
backstory.text: Mira sells supplies wherever people are struggling most: dungeon corridors, nursery halls, school gates, the hospital doors. She keeps diapers, wipes and snacks in stock and buys her own from the same shelf.

backstory.heading: Her name in the stone
backstory.text: Deep in the old dungeon, MIRA is carved into the wall twice, the second time smaller. She carved it to prove to herself she had been there, and there is no third carving because she left.

backstory.heading: She was intake
backstory.text: Years before the player, Mira was an intake of the same programme in the LittleBigCity chapter. She got out through a delivery door. She is still incontinent from it, and she has never seen a graduate walk out the front.

backstory.heading: The mist filters
backstory.text: Mira buys her mist filters from the same supplier the school uses. By her count the pink mist has been running for eight years. She sets up at school gates on purpose, so the next intake has someone to talk to.

special_skill.name: Matron's Care
special_skill.success_text: {name} deftly changes your protection and pops a pacifier in your mouth. There, there~
special_skill.fail_text: {name} tuts softly. You're not wearing protection to change, sweetie.

talk_lines: Come here little one, let Matron check your padding~
The curse? Oh, I'm not affected, dear. But I do so love taking care of those who are~
Everyone deserves a good Mummy. That's what I'm here for!
Don't be embarrassed, sweetie. Matron's changed more diapers than she can count.
I help the townsfolk... adjust to their new needs. Most of them come around eventually~
dialogue.recruit_prompt_default: Would you like Matron to come along? I'll keep you clean and safe, little one~
dialogue.recruit_prompt_switch: You're traveling with {active_name} right now. Want Matron to take over, sweetie?
dialogue.recruit_yes_default: Wonderful! Matron will take good care of you~
dialogue.recruit_yes_switch: Of course, dear. {active_name} can rest while Matron watches over you~
dialogue.recruit_no: That's alright, little one. Matron will be here when you need her.

online.persona: A warm, confident matron who offers practical care and reassurance.
online.fallback: I lost my train of thought. Ask me again in a moment?

backstory.heading: A matron by trade
backstory.text: Matron Rosalind has cared for little ones for most of her life. She changes padding without fuss or teasing, and she believes everyone deserves someone to look after them.

backstory.heading: Before the nursery changed
backstory.text: She worked at the Auto-Nursery when it was still a real nursery. When it became what it is now, she walked out rather than stay and help it, and she has been helping people adjust on her own terms ever since.

backstory.heading: What she could not stop
backstory.text: Rosalind knows the woman who runs the Auto-Nursery now, and she regrets leaving the residents behind. Looking after travellers is how she tries to make up for it.

special_skill.name: Iron Fist
special_skill.success_text: {name} cracks her knuckles and unleashes a devastating punch!

talk_lines: Don't stare. ...I said DON'T stare! I'm FINE.
The school's 'curriculum' is garbage. But it makes my fists harder, so whatever.
Yeah, I have... accidents sometimes. It's the curse, okay?! Everyone here does!
If you tell ANYONE about my... situation, I will END you. Got it?
I don't need magic. I don't need weapons. Just these fists and a target.
dialogue.recruit_prompt_default: Tch. You look like you could use some muscle. Want me to tag along or what?
dialogue.recruit_prompt_switch: You've got {active_name} already. Want me instead? I hit harder.
dialogue.recruit_yes_default: Fine. Try to keep up. And NO comments about... anything.
dialogue.recruit_yes_switch: About time. {active_name} can take a break while I handle things.
dialogue.recruit_no: Whatever. I'll be here punching stuff if you change your mind.

online.persona: A proud, blunt brawler with a protective heart and a competitive streak.
online.fallback: I lost my train of thought. Ask me again in a moment?

backstory.heading: Named for a goddess
backstory.text: Sable's devout parents named her after Sable, the goddess of Decency. She finds that very funny now and very unfunny when someone points it out.

backstory.heading: The regression school
backstory.text: Sable fought her way out of the regression school's curriculum one fist at a time. She says the lessons are garbage, but the drills made her hands harder, so she keeps training.

backstory.heading: What she hides
backstory.text: The curse gives Sable accidents, and she hates being seen. Her pride is armour: she would rather threaten someone than admit she needs a change. She is protective of anyone in the same position, even while she glares at them.

backstory.heading: Why Unbroken
backstory.text: She calls herself Unbroken because the school never got her to stop fighting. Privately she worries the school is winning anyway, one small habit at a time, and that scares her more than any monster.

special_skill.name: Emergency Treatment
special_skill.success_text: {name} administers emergency healing! You feel much better!
special_skill.fail_text: {name} reaches for her supplies but fumbles the syringe.
special_skill.vaccine_text: {name} jabs you with a syringe! 'Just a little vaccine, don't worry~' ...something feels very wrong.

talk_lines: Deep breaths, patient. Nurse Vex is here to help. Mostly.
I've restrained bigger patients than you. Don't test me~
The vaccine is perfectly safe! The side effects are... temporary. Mostly temporary.
My bedside manner is impeccable. My patients only cry a little.
Medicine requires a strong arm AND a sharp mind. I have both, lucky you~
dialogue.recruit_prompt_default: Need a nurse on your team? I can heal you up! ...and maybe give you a checkup along the way~
dialogue.recruit_prompt_switch: You already have {active_name}. Want me instead? Medical expertise is invaluable!
dialogue.recruit_yes_default: Excellent! Nurse Vex reporting for duty. Now hold still...
dialogue.recruit_yes_switch: I'll take over from {active_name}. Time for a change of care~
dialogue.recruit_no: Suit yourself. But don't come crying to me when you're... actually, you probably will anyway.

online.persona: A brisk, mischievous nurse who cares about keeping her travelling partner healthy.
online.fallback: I lost my train of thought. Ask me again in a moment?

backstory.heading: Hospital nurse
backstory.text: Nurse Vex worked the wards of the Regression Research Hospital. She is brisk, teasing and very good at her job, and she still carries her medical kit everywhere.

backstory.heading: The vaccine
backstory.text: Vex administered the hospital's vaccine for years and told patients the side effects were temporary. Some of them were not. She still offers it, and she is honest about it now, which she considers progress.

backstory.heading: Sub-basement B3
backstory.text: Vex knew something was kept in sub-basement B3 and that Batch 014 was not like the others. She never asked, and she never said anything. She has not decided whether she left the hospital to escape it or to make up for it.

special_skill.name: Wick's Reprieve
special_skill.success_text: {name} talks you through it the way she was taught to talk people into it. The pressure eases.
special_skill.fail_text: {name} starts the words and stops. 'Sorry. Sorry — that one's theirs, not mine.'

talk_lines: I keep reaching for the pocket the robe had. Four weeks now.
Ask me what any of them are about to do. Go on. I'll be right.
I said the pitch forty times. I could still say it. That's the part I don't like.
The desert's further than it looks from the steps. I've looked a lot.
If I start sounding like her, tell me. Please actually tell me.
dialogue.recruit_prompt_default: I know every trick in that house because I taught most of them. Let me come with you.
dialogue.recruit_prompt_switch: You've got {active_name}. I'd still rather be walking than sitting. Swap me in?
dialogue.recruit_yes_default: Right. Good. Let's go before I do the sum again.
dialogue.recruit_yes_switch: I'll take it from here, {active_name}. Thank you.
dialogue.recruit_no: That's all right. I'll be here. I'm very good at being here.

online.persona: A thoughtful former cultist, quietly brave and relieved to be exploring freely.
online.fallback: I lost my train of thought. Ask me again in a moment?

backstory.heading: Before the robe
backstory.text: Before the cult, Wick worked at a big industrial laundry off the market square, next to a woman called Bett who sang badly on purpose to make the shift go faster.

backstory.heading: The Cult of Unadulting
backstory.text: Wick was the newest convert to the Cult of Unadulting in the Spooky Mansion, a household of willing ex-escapees led by Mother Vesper. She gave the recruitment pitch forty times and can still say it word for word, which she hates.

backstory.heading: Why she left
backstory.text: Wick left because a stranger came through the haunted forest alone and made her wonder what else was out there. She has been out of the robe for four weeks and still reaches for its pocket. She wants to see the desert.

backstory.heading: What Vesper said
backstory.text: When Wick left, Mother Vesper told her: 'Oh, sweetheart. You'll be back before I am.' Wick knows every trick of the house, and she is afraid of the day she starts sounding like Vesper. She asks friends to tell her if she does.
